correctness.rationale: The displayed edges form trees. The bare path 4–5–6 with degree-two internal vertex 5 defines a proper KC move that changes four leaves to five. Two independent exact methods yield means \(73/15\) and \(34/7\) and difference \(-1/105\): first-vertex rational recursion on induced subsets and exhaustive enumeration of all 362880 permutations. Exhaustive leaf-extension generation of all 1-to-9-vertex unlabelled trees, complete isomorphism reduction, and exact evaluation of every proper KC endpoint pair found no smaller negative difference (orders 1 through 8: 0 negative moves). The standard-library checker was replayed successfully.

value.rationale: Resolves negatively a concrete proposed monotonicity of actual expected greedy maximal-independent-set cardinality along KC tree transformations, and identifies the first possible tree order. This changes the interpretation of a natural tree-order approach to random greedy algorithms and distinguishes the previously proved auxiliary-functional monotonicity from the genuinely false strengthening. A small absolute expectation gap is sufficient to refute the universal assertion.
